qa_pairs.question: What are the usage restrictions for the SHARCNET Ansys license on Alliance systems?
qa_pairs.answer: The SHARCNET Ansys license is available free for academic use by any Alliance researcher on any Alliance system, with no solver or geometry limits. However, its use is strictly restricted to "Publishable Academic Research" and is prohibited for any private or commercial purposes, as per the license terms.

qa_pairs.question: What are the core limits for using the SHARCNET Ansys license, and what actions can a researcher take if they need more cores?
qa_pairs.answer: The SHARCNET Ansys license is provided on a first-come, first-served basis. Currently, each researcher can run a maximum of 16 simultaneous jobs, utilizing up to 512 HPC cores across all clusters. However, this total `anshpc` core limit per researcher will be reduced to 384 on April 1, 2026. Due to the license being oversubscribed, jobs may fail to start if all (or nearly all) of the 1986 `anshpc` licenses in the pool are in use. If a researcher requires more than 384 HPC cores for their research, they should either use a local Ansys License server from their institution or open a ticket to request purchasing additional SHARCNET licenses that would be reserved for their exclusive use.
